name: Nonorientable four-genus of 2,537 of the 3,525 knots with 11 to 13 crossings left open by KnotInfo (partial result)
target: gamma_4(K) for the prime knots with 11 to 13 crossings whose KnotInfo 2026.10.5 entry is an interval
result: Settled for 2,537 knots (520 at gamma_4 = 1, 1,995 at gamma_4 = 2, 22 at gamma_4 = 3). Upper bounds: one pinch move to a slice knot or to a knot of known gamma_4, checked in Regina. Lower bounds: the published Arf and linking-form obstructions, and for 382 alternating knots the Goeritz-lattice obstructions of Jabuka and Kelly from Donaldson's theorem, by an exhaustive embedding search. The interval of 376 more is narrowed; 988 stay open. The fourth pass added 444 knots.

notes.formal: no Lean; every pinch certificate is checked in Regina by crosscap4d/verify/verify.py and every lower bound by crosscap4d/lower/verify_lower.py in the repository; construct/goeritz_lattice.py recomputes the 382 lower bounds with the standard library
